note: Expected observations, not canned production model responses. Model wording may vary. All examples use the normal upload endpoints.

postgres.observation: Connection to PostgreSQL is refused and application startup aborts.
postgres.possible_cause: PostgreSQL may not be listening or reachable at the configured address; credentials are not proven wrong by ECONNREFUSED.

missing-env.observation: APP_SECRET is not set and application startup aborts.
missing-env.possible_cause: The required variable may not have been passed into this process.

port-in-use.observation: The HTTP server fails to bind 0.0.0.0:8000 with address already in use.
port-in-use.possible_cause: Another process may already own the port.

healthy.observation: Configuration, database, migrations, listener and health request succeed in this sample.
missing_context: A startup excerpt cannot prove long-term system health
